# MATCHA Inc.

> > MATCHA Inc. is one of Japan's largest multilingual media platforms specializing in inbound tourism, providing travel content, tourism consulting, and marketing services for visitors to Japan.

The company offers comprehensive tourism solutions including content creation, whitepapers on visitor analytics, and regional tourism development partnerships with organizations like the Japan Tourism Agency. MATCHA works with regions across Japan including Fukuoka, Kyoto, and Ehime Prefecture to promote local tourism.
